# pingpp

> CLI in C++ that measures latency and jitter to a list of host:port targets using plain TCP connect timing, no ICMP and no administrator rights required.

Written for Windows, built with CMake and MSVC.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ImSavsis/pingpp/blob/master/README.md): build and usage instructions, architecture diagram
- [src/main.cpp](https://github.com/ImSavsis/pingpp/blob/master/src/main.cpp): non-blocking connect timing and jitter calculation
